name: Lost Point
summary: At Lost Point in western Dustwallow, deserters have driven out Lady Jaina Proudmoore's guard. Theramore built the tower as an advance scout post, but it has fallen into disrepair.

sections.title: A Forsaken Outpost
sections.body: Lost Point once watched the Barrens for traffic and threats on Theramore's behalf. Its military purpose passed, and marsh damp rotted the timber. Regular troops abandoned the defenses. Now human deserters from Theramore hold the tower and the nearby ground. They found shelter in this isolated wilderness, far from the discipline of the city's commanders.

sections.title: Den of Deserters
sections.body: Balos Jacken leads the deserters at Lost Point. A disgruntled former soldier, Jacken holds key testimony with his followers about traitorous elements within Theramore's ranks. Their testimony includes Private Hendel's part in a conspiracy that reaches into the Alliance's upper ranks.

faq.answer: Lost Point is a rundown watchtower in western Dustwallow, built by Theramore's humans as an advance scout post. The military abandoned it, and deserters now occupy it.

faq.q: Who lives at Lost Point right now?
faq.answer: Theramore deserters live in the tower and the camp around it. These human soldiers abandoned their oaths and follow Balos Jacken.
Balos Jacken leads the Theramore deserters hiding at Lost Point. He holds crucial intelligence about troubling matters in Theramore's ranks.

faq.q: Why did Theramore abandon the tower?
faq.answer: Dustwallow Marsh is hostile and difficult to supply. As morale fell and discipline frayed among the garrison, the isolated tower decayed. It became shelter for soldiers escaping duty without fleeing into Horde territory.

angles.text: As an Alliance loyalist, Lost Point is a bitter sign of fraying discipline in Theramore's ranks. Renegades there hold key testimonies about military treason.
